<p align="center">by <a href="https://github.com/domfortunato">Dom Bosco</a></p>

<p align="center">Base Knavery is an unofficial, fan-made Foundry VTT system for Knave, first and second editions.<br>Questing Beast LLC did not make it and has not endorsed it.</p>

## System Rules

- **Knave is built in.** A new world plays Ben Milton's original Knave as written. Its rules, tables and spells come with the system.
- **Knave 2e relies on your purchased copy of the book.** Upload your Knave 2e PDF and build its tables, and you'll be offered a switch to 2e rules. Characters you already have don't change.
- **Mix them.** Each rule has its own switch in Game Settings, under Configure Rules.

## Buy the books!

Both editions of Knave were written by Ben Milton.

- **Knave**: [PDF on Itch](https://questingbeast.itch.io/knave). Its rules are already in the system. Buying the PDF supports its author.
- **Knave 2e**: [PDF on DriveThruRPG](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/en/product/484910/knave-second-edition-2e?affiliate_id=379088) · [PDF on Itch](https://questingbeast.itch.io/knave-second-edition) · [In print](https://shop.swordfishislands.com/questing-beast/)

## AI disclosure

- 🖌️ **No AI art.** Base Knavery ships with more than 2,900 human-made art assets (portraits, tokens and icons) and will never use AI-generated art.
- 📜 **No AI game text.** No spell, item or monster description was written by AI.
- 🧠 **Base Knavery's code is written with the help of an AI coding assistant.**

<!-- welcome:end -->

## Install

In Foundry's **Game Systems → Install System**, paste the manifest URL:

```
https://github.com/domfortunato/base-knavery-foundryvtt/releases/latest/download/system.json
```

## What you get

- A complete system that runs Knave (the first edition) out of the box, with its CC BY 4.0 rules included.
- Full Knave 2e support, with rich content, once you upload your own copy of the Knave 2e PDF to your Foundry server.
- Instant random character creation for PCs, NPCs and monsters.
- A random spell generator.
- A bestiary, and more than 2,900 pieces of human-made art (portraits, tokens and icons).
- A fully customizable marketplace.
- Fully customizable backgrounds, weapons, gear, spells, magic items and potions.
- GM macros for importing additional tables, quickly turning features on and off, and more.
- A complete guide, in the compendium, that explains every feature.
